_comment: Optional per-destination overrides. Key = destination key (see build/<market>/destinations.json). 'prompt' replaces the photo prompt entirely; 'place' replaces only the '{place}' part of the default prompt; 'skip': true keeps the original feed image for that destination.

london-united-kingdom.place: London, United Kingdom, with the Thames, Tower Bridge and the Houses of Parliament

new-york-city-united-states.place: New York City, Manhattan skyline with the Empire State Building

paris-france.place: Paris, France, with the Eiffel Tower and Haussmann rooftops

rome-italy.place: Rome, Italy, with the Colosseum, terracotta rooftops and St. Peter's dome

tokyo-japan.place: Tokyo, Japan, skyline with Tokyo Tower and Mount Fuji in the distance

washington-united-states.place: Washington D.C., United States, with the Capitol and the National Mall

melbourne-united-states.place: Melbourne, Florida, United States, Atlantic beachfront and the Indian River

san-jose-united-states.place: San Jose, California, downtown skyline and Santa Cruz mountains

santiago-dominican-republic.place: Santiago de los Caballeros, Dominican Republic, Monumento a los Heroes de la Restauracion
